decision.reason: The only evidence, a one-line changelog entry [ev-d78886a20329], says Argo CD now stops the in-cluster cluster from being used when it is disabled. That supports a behavior change, but the entry doesn't name what the change applies to. It doesn't say which setting disables in-cluster (a config key, a cluster resource or something else), so the subject can't be pinned to a family and identity. The proposed protocol-behavior subject doesn't fit, because this isn't wire or protocol behaviour, and its name includes "enforcement", a word the evidence never uses. The PR (#21208) or docs naming the disable mechanism would be needed to settle the subject.
